latest.title: No upcoming Flarum release needs checking
latest.description: Your forum meets the requirements of every Flarum release Upgrade Advisor knows about. When a release with new requirements is announced, an update to Upgrade Advisor will check your forum's readiness for it.

overall.tasks: Ready once {count, plural, one {# task is} other {# tasks are}} done
overall.unchecked_only: Nearly ready: {count, plural, one {# extension} other {# extensions}} couldn't be checked

reasons.no_path: {count, plural, one {# extension has} other {# extensions have}} no {target} path
reasons.unchecked: {count, plural, one {# extension} other {# extensions}} couldn't be checked

php-version.title: PHP version

php-version.fail: PHP {current} is installed, but {required} or newer is required.

database-version.title: Database version
database-version.warning_unknown: Could not determine the database server version.

summary.data_as_of_help: Package lookups are cached for up to 6 hours. Refresh to fetch the latest.

decision.title: Needs a decision
decision.description: No {target}-ready release yet: ask the author about their plans, or plan to go without.

unknown.title: Couldn't check
unknown.description: Usually premium or private extensions. Add repository access so the advisor can check them.

replace.title: Remove or replace
replace.description: Remove these before upgrading; install any replacements once the upgrade is done.

hints.remove: Remove before upgrading. It's built into Flarum {target}, so nothing replaces it.
hints.swap_after_upgrade: Remove before upgrading, then install {replacement} after the upgrade.
hints.switch_replacement: Abandoned. Remove before upgrading, then install {replacement} ({target}-ready) after the upgrade.
hints.switch_replacement_unverified: Abandoned. Remove before upgrading, then install {replacement} after the upgrade. Check it supports {target} first.
hints.no_path: No {target} release yet (latest is {version}). Ask the author about plans, or plan to remove it.
hints.no_path_unversioned: Not {target}-compatible yet. Ask the author about plans, or plan to remove it.
hints.no_path_abandoned: Abandoned with no replacement. Plan to remove it or find an alternative.
hints.unknown: Not found on Packagist or any configured repository. If it's premium or private, add repository access.

repositories.help: Add private or marketplace Composer repositories so the advisor can check extensions that aren't on public Packagist. Used only when an extension can't be found on Packagist.
